rationale.legacy_1000000_bytes: Historical compatibility value introduced only to fit the Google Sheets IMPORTDATA/result envelope. It is not an optimal Render-to-sandbox transport size.
rationale.render_capacity: Render previously fetched and SHA-256 verified the complete 2497280256-byte model, so upstream/Render model size is not the limiting dimension.
rationale.remaining_unknown: Maximum reliable single response accepted by the ChatGPT-side ingress path.

tcc_selection.probe_rule: Try each declared size once from largest to smallest through the actual end-to-end receiving path. Select the first size that completes with exact byte length and matching X-Part-SHA256.
tcc_selection.freeze_rule: Once selected, use the same part size for the full run. Do not tune manually mid-run.
tcc_selection.failure_rule: If a selected size later has one transient failure, retry that part once. A second transport-size failure restarts the run at the next smaller predeclared size; model bytes and acceptance criteria remain unchanged.
tcc_selection.terminal_pass: Whole file size and SHA-256 exactly match the model registry.
